entries.0adf6a51b8c1a60f: A monthly subscription fashion rental service for men started on May 28, 2026. entries.6b825456432849bb: A monthly subscription service started in February 2015 that lets customers rent clothing selected by stylists, entirely online without face-to-face contact. The Regular Plan costs ¥10,980 per month; 3 items are chosen and sent at a time, and the next clothing is sent once the return is confirmed. There are also the Light Plan at ¥7,980 per month and the Light Plus Plan at ¥13,980 per month. Customers can purchase clothing they like. The securities report states that at the end of June 2026 there were 35 thousand monthly members and 1.6 million free members, and that the number of members at the end of the fiscal year was lower than at the same point in the previous year.
entries.6bfd13f9b63fe9b9: A pay-per-use service that uses the circular logistics platform to rent dresses worn at weddings and events. The securities report states that "airCloset Dress" started in November 2024, and that from October 2025 the scope was expanded to include black formal wear and outerwear, with efforts to raise awareness as "airCloset Spot Rental".
entries.8c3125deb9c87077: Provision of the circular logistics platform "AC-PORT" to external companies
entries.8d66fc1c5a09f391: The company's only business segment. Centered on "airCloset", a monthly subscription service that rents clothing selected by stylists to match each person's tastes to women living in Japan, it also operates "airCloset Mall", a rental mall where customers can try and buy home appliances, bedding and similar items, pay-per-use rental of dresses for weddings and events, and external sales of its logistics platform. The securities report omits segment-level disclosure because the company is a single segment with the Personal Styling Business as its only business segment. Revenue for the fiscal year ended June 2026 was ¥5,175,679 thousand (up 4.4% from the previous fiscal year) and operating loss was ¥234,470 thousand (compared with operating profit of ¥102,423 thousand in the previous fiscal year). The securities report states that monthly membership fees and sales from "airCloset" account for about 87% of revenue.
entries.952ff7d379074ce3: A service started in April 2020 that provides manufacturers handling lifestyle products such as home appliances with a platform for subscription-type rental sales. Customers can try products at home before considering a purchase. Revenue consists of platform usage fees received from manufacturers, and a portion of rental revenue received from customers and of sales revenue linked to purchases (revenue share). Depending on the product, the company may purchase directly.
